summary: Civil Air Patrol Thompson Valley Composite Squadron training flight (aerial photography mission) crashed in the remote Storm Mountain area of Larimer County; three aboard — two passengers confirmed deceased, one transported to hospital with serious injuries. Recovery of the two deceased took multiple days due to extreme rugged terrain; LCSO led the investigation with FAA/NTSB support.
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Search and Rescue; Civil Air Patrol (Thompson Valley Composite Squadron); Loveland Fire Rescue Authority
notes: Alpine mission 2024-160 assist folded in: Alpine Rescue Team sent two State SAR coordinators and two rescue technicians to assist Larimer County SAR. Larimer County Spotlight (2024-11-23) gives the full crash account: CAP Thompson Valley Composite Squadron plane on a routine aerial-photography training mission; 3 aboard; 2 fatalities + 1 serious injury. run 791 merge: NFN recovery-day report on the 2024-11-23 (Saturday) Thompson Valley CAP Storm Mountain crash (2 fatalities + 1 serious injury; article's 'Saturday, November 24' is a day-name typo — Nov 23 was the Saturday).
